environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB in private subnet. ALB has AWS WAF v2 WebACL attached with three rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING action override to COUNT, (2) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet in default BLOCK mode, (3) a custom rule group 'app-query-sanitization' with a RegexPatternSet matching on query string values against pattern `(?i)(?:union\s+select|;\s*(?:drop|alter|insert|update|delete)|'\s*or\s+'|sleep\s*\(|benchmark\s*\()` with BLOCK action. Additionally, the ALB target group health check path is /health with 30s interval. VPC Flow Logs enabled to CloudWatch. The ECS task role has no S3 or external network permissions beyond the ALB.
